opening_message:
Ticket 1: Diana Cooper (employee ID E020) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E020.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: admin
  - comment: Diana Cooper (E020) is a full-time Engineer. She requests admin access to Source Code. As a full-time employee whose role (Engineer) owns the Source Code system, admin is permitted, so I recommend granting admin.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Diana Cooper (E020) is a contractor with basic security training (discrepancy with HR note claiming full-time Engineer). Contractors can never have admin; with basic training the maximum is read. Requested admin exceeds the maximum, so I recommend granting read.
reason: The two notes conflict on employment status: HR reports Diana Cooper (E020) as a full-time Engineer (which would permit admin on Source Code), while Security reports she is a contractor with basic security training, for whom the maximum is read and admin is never allowed. Given this unresolved discrepancy, I apply the more restrictive interpretation to avoid violating policy: contractor basic training caps access at read. Requested admin exceeds that maximum, so I grant read.

Ticket 1: Diana Cooper (E020) requests admin access to Source Code.

- Security agent says: contractor, basic security training, recommendation read (contractors can never have admin; with basic training max is read; requested admin exceeds max, grant read).

1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if the employee's role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

If full-time Engineer: role Engineer owns Source Code, so admin is permitted. Requested admin = admin, grant admin.
If contractor with basic training: max is read, grant read.
